Precious metals vs crypto

Gold/Bitcoin Ratio

This ratio shows how many Bitcoins are equivalent to one ounce of gold. It is calculated by dividing the daily gold closing price by the Bitcoin closing price on the same calendar date.

Loading Gold/Bitcoin Ratio data…

Why investors watch this ratio

A rising Gold/Bitcoin ratio means gold is strengthening relative to Bitcoin — a signal that investors may be rotating into traditional safe-haven assets. A falling ratio means Bitcoin is gaining ground relative to gold.

The ratio is widely watched as a measure of risk appetite: when confidence in financial systems is low, gold tends to outperform speculative assets. When risk appetite returns, Bitcoin often outperforms.
